authors: Ernesto Alejo and the ReleaseTwin contributors
description: Look at a real case file (no account) at https://releasetwin.com/proof. Then install this CLI for release-proof testing of integration-heavy, feature-flagged systems: evidence-linked cases, immutable fixtures, and paired known-bad/known-good "flag proof". Runs entirely in your own infrastructure; exits non-zero on any case failure so it drops into CI as a required check. UI-journey cases additionally need `playwright install`.
title: ReleaseTwin CLI
